title: Incremental loads: replay and late arrivals
requirement: Return violation_count = mismatched FULL JOIN rows plus duplicated order_id groups. Expected is the latest (event_at,event_id) per key from incremental_events WHERE arrived_at <= lab_context.as_of. A mismatch is a missing/unexpected key or distinct event_id,event_at,net_amount. This is a sum of rule violations, not unique bad orders. Grading rebuilds independent fully processed fixtures regardless of your current simulation step.
learning_objectives: Distinguish event time from arrival time
Prove replay safety and correct latest-state upserts
